email_body:
Hey Justin!

Saw your question about organizing and keeping track of your take notes and amp settings. You just unlocked Stage 2 of the Sovereign AI Academy: Markdown & The Karpathy Minimal Wiki.

In audio and AI engineering, proprietary Word docs and messy text dumps create friction for AI models. Markdown (.md) is lightweight, renders everywhere, and lets LLMs parse headers, tables, and code blocks with zero hallucination.

Check out the newly unlocked Lab 7 on your hub: https://justin-netops-hub.web.app
We've added a template studio run sheet and a guide to building a Karpathy-style single-folder knowledge wiki.
